name: Opening & closing
strength: You greeted Katy professionally and closed with a clear recap of the .com.br transfer steps and an offer of further help.
improvement: Greet Katy warmly and close with a recap of the correct next steps.

name: Use Dynamics
strength: You used User Manager/SBS to confirm Katy is the verified owner-of-record and that the domain is a Wix-registered .com.br before proceeding.
improvement: Use User Manager/SBS to confirm the domain's registrar, type (.com.br), and owner before advising on the transfer.

name: Familiarize
strength: You asked a meaningful question about Katy's agency work, building rapport with a fellow Wix Partner.
improvement: Ask a familiarization question that connects to the user's role or business.

name: Clarify the issue
strength: You clarified that Katy wants a full registration transfer (not just a DNS repoint), confirmed the registrant email and GoDaddy access, and distinguished connecting from transferring.
improvement: Clarify whether the user wants to transfer registration or only repoint DNS, confirm the registrant contact email, and confirm they can accept the transfer at the gaining registrar (GoDaddy).

name: Roadmapping
strength: You outlined a clear plan — confirm eligibility via Whois, pull the correct steps, then walk through initiating the transfer — before acting.
improvement: Give a clear roadmap of the diagnostic checks and transfer steps before taking action.

name: Recreate the issue
strength: You ran a Whois lookup to confirm the domain was active, unlocked, and not in redemption before advising on the transfer.
improvement: Use Whois to confirm domain status (ok / not locked / not in redemption / no 60-day lock) before providing transfer steps.

name: Article / Copilot
strength: You consulted 'Transferring Your Wix Domain Away from Wix' together with 'Domains Brazil: Market Specific Topics' rather than relying on the generic flow alone.
improvement: Open 'Transferring Your Wix Domain Away from Wix' and 'Domains Brazil: Market Specific Topics' to confirm the exact steps for a .com.br.

name: Solve the issue
strength: You correctly identified that .com.br transfers are initiated from Registro.br (not Wix), advised cancelling Wix auto-renewal first, and set accurate expectations on timing and cancellation.
improvement: Explain that .com.br transfers start at Registro.br, that auto-renewal must be cancelled in Wix first, and give accurate timing/cancellation guidance.
